name: Littoral-Tombolo

civilization.name: Vaerid Compact
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: A killed landscape, vacuum-scoured and silent. The regolith holds bootprints beautifully; there are some near an orbital debris ring that no expedition has ever claimed.
No wind, no voice, no weather: the landscape communicates in light and shadow alone, and it has plenty to say at sunrise.
Nothing about the temporal distortion zone appears on any natural-phenomena registry. The leading research institutions classify it as 'pending,' which is science's word for afraid.
There is money in iron here, and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
